exit 0
--- stdout
read_dir d dir=true link=false
read_dir dangling dir=false link=true
read_dir f.txt dir=false link=false
read_dir ld dir=false link=true
read_dir lf dir=false link=true
walk d dir=true link=false
walk dangling dir=false link=true
walk f.txt dir=false link=false
walk ld dir=false link=true
walk lf dir=false link=true
stat f.txt name=f.txt dir=false size=5 link=false
stat lf name=lf dir=false size=5 link=false
stat ld name=ld dir=true size=- link=false
stat d name=d dir=true size=- link=false
stat dangling true
--- stderr
